content: Vercel deployment for Next.js 16: (1) Node runtime: Vercel default is now Node 24.x. Add engines.node = '>=20.9.0' (or '22.x') to package.json. Next.js 16 minimum is Node 20.9.0 — NOT satisfied by local Node 18.14.0, must upgrade before dev. (2) Streaming: Vercel supports streaming natively with Node.js runtime — no extra config needed. Fluid compute is enabled by default for new projects since April 2025 — reduces cold starts. (3) maxDuration: current cover-letter route has maxDuration=120, parse has maxDuration=60 — both need to fit within Vercel hobby plan limits (60s max on hobby, 300s on pro). Watch this: hobby plan limits functions to 60s, so cover-letter's 120s maxDuration will be silently capped. Recommend upgrading to Vercel pro or reducing to 60s. (4) ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: must be set as a Vercel environment variable — not committed to git. (5) Deploy: just push to GitHub, connect Vercel project — zero-config Next.js detection.
